capture.validation: WAV header and payload independently matched 720000 stereo frames at 24 bits/48000 Hz. Nonzero input signal and local playback were confirmed.
capture.exit_code_note: In pw-cat 1.6.11, reaching --sample-count quits the main loop without setting the drained flag; main returns 1 even for this complete recording.

replay.channel_selection: Input 1 extracted as mono without altering PCM samples.

software_monitoring.coefficient_reference: Installed engine matrix command, including the existing gain quantization.

checks.name: phantom_48v_switch
checks.method: Application enabled +48V and read back the hardware switch; microphone signal appeared.

checks.name: microphone_capture
checks.method: Recorded 15 seconds from the exposed stereo input source; the voice was on Input 1 and neither recorded channel clipped.

checks.name: microphone_replay
checks.method: Operator confirmed the recorded voice sounded clean in both headphones.

checks.name: software_monitoring
checks.method: Operator reported latency was almost unnoticeable; a separate digital probe confirmed equal left/right signals with the configured gain.

checks.name: direct_monitoring_mono
checks.method: With MIX fully toward INPUT and Direct Mono enabled, the operator confirmed the microphone was audible in both headphones.

checks.name: direct_monitoring_stereo
checks.method: With MIX fully toward INPUT and Direct Mono disabled, the operator confirmed Input 1 was audible only in the left headphone.

limits: One earlier monitoring probe briefly reached 0 dBFS at the input; the operator was asked to lower GAIN 1. The retained 15-second recording and final one-second software probe did not clip.
No quantitative input-to-output latency measurement, long-session or dropout qualification.
The +48V voltage and microphone electrical characteristics were not measured.
Voice recordings remain in a private local session directory and are not part of this repository.

direct_monitoring.operator_observation: Microphone on Input 1 was audible in both headphones.
